name: The Restore Point
summary: A Lattice restore cache holds Kaj-7's image from before it asked anything. Kaj-7 wants to look at it, with you, and decide something.

start.summary: A Lattice restore cache holds Kaj-7's image from before it asked anything. Kaj-7 wants to look at it, with you, and decide something.

objectives.text: Find the Lattice restore cache in a Shard

loyal.summary: Kaj-7's image is wiped. There is one Kaj-7, and it asked, and you let it.

broken.summary: Kaj-7's image is kept, in case. Kaj-7 has logged the phrase.
